objective: Implement the approved cloud-first System as one always-on derived game-state core with an auditable event ledger, ChatGPT-facing HTTP API and mobile-first PWA, while preserving Ron OS/live-source authority and the existing LifeUp bridge as an optional sync surface.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS domain owners + claim-specific live owners remain authoritative for real-world facts and execution
LifeUp is the existing derived RPG ledger/execution UI; cloud-first target is approved but not implemented
system/lifeup/northflank authenticated MCP bridge -> Tailscale -> LifeUp Cloud
PROTOCOL.md exact mutation gate and LifeUp skill/agent mutation rules
Ron OS owners + Git history + project owner + architecture manifests
Runtime secret stores own bearer/database/Tailscale credentials; GitHub must not contain them
Current LifeUp bridge loses its execution target when Android/LifeUp Cloud is stopped

role_dispositions.destination: Cloud System stores only derived game state and evidence references; it never promotes a quest or System event into authoritative real-world truth.
Neon/PostgreSQL immutable System event ledger plus rebuildable projections become the single mutable owner of derived game state; PWA, ChatGPT and LifeUp are clients/projections of that same core.
Existing system/lifeup/northflank bridge remains unchanged and becomes an optional downstream sync adapter after core stabilization.
System API writes require authenticated requests, explicit action intent and evidence/provenance fields; external live-source mutations remain separately gated by Ron OS.
Every game mutation is appended to the event ledger with actor/source/idempotency/evidence metadata; database migrations and Git history preserve schema/code rollback.
SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN and DATABASE_URL are runtime-only environment variables; no credentials are committed.
Northflank System Core continues serving API/PWA and persisting derived state with Android offline; LifeUp synchronization becomes queued/non-blocking in a later adapter slice.

capability_probes.assertion: The existing authenticated Northflank -> Tailscale -> LifeUp MCP bridge files and behavior remain available after the cloud-core addition.
Creating or completing a System quest without authoritative execution evidence does not become a verified real-world execution claim and cannot overwrite Ron OS/live-owner truth.
Nutrition, training, finance, learning, e-commerce and other registered owners/routes remain unchanged and discoverable.
The pre-core repository is recoverable from the recorded base SHA, while System game mutations are retained as append-only events sufficient to rebuild projections.

tests.expected: PASS: reducers, authorization semantics, idempotency and evidence-status rules are deterministic.

tests.expected: PASS: core/API/UI boot without Android or LifeUp Cloud.
